rules.action: Enters and leaves the grid — one tab stop, as DataGrid.
Next / previous visible row, same column. Collapsed descendants are skipped because they are not rendered.
On a collapsed row header: expands. On an expanded row header: moves to the next cell. On any other cell: next cell.
On a row header of an expanded row: collapses. On a row header of a collapsed or leaf row: moves focus to the parent row's header. On any other cell: previous cell.
First / last cell in the row (Ctrl: first / last visible row of the grid).
On a row header: toggles expansion (or activates a control inside it). Elsewhere as DataGrid: sort, edit, activate.
Expands every row at the focused row's level under the same parent, the focused row included.
As DataGrid (Shift+Space extends the row selection; with selectChildren each selected parent cascades).
